text:
alex: Quick coordination ask — PR #4279 is green locally but CI has been flaky on mac-e2e. We have a rebase window tomorrow 2026-03-20 03:00 UTC and a deploy freeze starting 2026-03-20 06:00 UTC. I'd like to land this before the freeze if possible; can anyone take point on the CI reruns/eyes? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4279

jamie: Thanks for the ping. Which jobs are failing? If it's mac-e2e again we might need a staggered canary to avoid impacting the main rollout.

alex: Failing jobs: `mac-e2e-14` and occasionally `integration-db-serial`. Example failing log:```
FAILED tests/e2e/login.test.js > timeout after 120000ms
  at waitForElement (tests/e2e/helpers.js:42:12)
  at Object.<anonymous> (tests/e2e/login.test.js:14:5)
```
I've retried once, flakes reappeared.

ci-bot: CI rerun queued for PR #4279 (requested by alex). Current queue position: 3. Status: flaky-retry-policy applied.

sarah: I can rebase + push a deterministic change to warm the cache and trigger a fresh matrix. Give me 30m to rebase and run subset locally, will ping when done. @jamie can you volunteer to watch the CI runs?

jamie: Yep I can watch the run. If mac-e2e is the blocker we should avoid landing during the high-traffic window. What canary window do we have?

matt: Canary idea — land to dedicated canary pool during 01:00–03:00 UTC, watch 30m, then promote if stable. But that collides slightly with the rebase window. If sarah rebases early we can aim to push into the canary right after.

alex: Proposed plan: sarah rebases now, we trigger CI, jamie watches. If canary passes by 02:30 UTC we promote; otherwise we hold and schedule for next non-freeze window. That keeps us away from 06:00 freeze.

sarah: Rebased and pushed (`git push --force-with-lease`). Triggered `mac-e2e-14` and `integration-db-serial` locally once — looked okay. CI link: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/4279

ci-bot: CI status update for PR #4279 — mac-e2e-14: RUNNING, integration-db-serial: RUNNING.

jamie: Watching now. mac-e2e shows one flaky test rerun in progress. If it flakes again we should consider isolating test or marking flaky with issue.

ci-bot: mac-e2e-14 finished: PASSED. integration-db-serial finished: PASSED. Overall: PASSED.

matt: Nice. Ready for canary push whenever you all are. Suggestion: land in small batch (1 instance) to canary pool first.

alex: @sarah can you kick the canary deploy? I'll queue the merge once deploy is green. Also please add the PR summary to the release notes draft.

sarah: Canary deploy kicked (`deploy/canary-pr-4279`). Will watch logs, ping here on progress.

ci-bot: Canary deploy started: deploy/canary-pr-4279 -> canary-pool-1. Health checks: pending.

jamie: Logs look clean so far. No error spikes in traces. Waiting 20 more minutes for steady-state.

sarah: Canary health checks green (30m). No regressions observed in tracing or error budget.

alex: Merging now — tagging as a small risk land, will monitor. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.

ci-bot: Merge queued: PR #4279 -> main. Merge will proceed after final CI gating checks.

matt: :thumbsup: good call on canary. We avoided the freeze window and kept the rollout smooth.

jamie: Added a follow-up ticket to investigate flaky mac-e2e test (TICKET-889). Assigning to eng-flakiness squad.

alex: Closing loop — PR landed and deploy promoted. Logged post-deploy notes in the release doc. Thanks all. :tada:
